observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A wood-floored auditorium or stage with red curtains and wooden acoustic wall panels.
observation.dancers: A mixed group of about 20 adults, including both men and women, dressed in uniform attire.
observation.formation_and_space: Arranged in a V-shape or wedge formation facing forward, standing in place without traveling.
observation.posture: Upright torso, straight back, weight balanced evenly on both feet with slightly soft or straight knees.
observation.footwork: Subtle stepping or weight shifts in place that cannot be seen in detail due to long robes and low camera angles; feet appear to step side-to-side or remain stationary on the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move in synchronized sequences: held at sides, extended forward horizontally, raised overhead with palms facing forward, or bent at elbows with hands near shoulders.
observation.hips_and_torso: Hips and torso remain mostly upright and still, focused on precise arm and hand positioning.
observation.partnering: None; dancers move independently in unison.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: No jumps, floor work, or turns; dancers remain standing at one level throughout.
observation.costume_and_props: Matching long dark red robes with light beige or grey sashes, light beige trousers, and dark shoes.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork details and weight transfers are obscured by long robes and stationary camera angles.

signature_moments.what: Dancers shift weight gently from side to side in place while keeping arms down at their sides.
Dancers raise arms forward, then upward and overhead with palms facing out in unison.
Dancers alternate extending arms straight forward and raising them vertically in a rhythmic sequence.
